dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。準備が出来ましたら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. We can begin whenever you're ready.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、大丈夫です！宜しくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm ready! Thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 派遣社員なのですが、派遣先が決まったとたん骨折で入院してしまったんです
dialogue.English: I'm a temporary employee, and right after I got a new placement, I broke a bone and had to be hospitalized.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、それは大変な想いをされましたね。。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: よろしければ年令と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 40才　女です
dialogue.English: I'm 40 years old, female.

dialogue.content: これからの事が不安で・・・
dialogue.English: I'm anxious about what's ahead...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。
dialogue.English: I can understand that.

dialogue.content: どこを骨折してしまったのですか？
dialogue.English: Where did you fracture the bone?

dialogue.content: 今日は何とお呼びしたら良いでしょうか?
dialogue.English: What would you like me to call you today?

dialogue.content: 骨盤です
dialogue.English: My pelvis.

dialogue.content: アキです
dialogue.English: You can call me Aki.

dialogue.content: それは大変ですね
dialogue.English: That sounds very serious.

dialogue.content: アキさんですね
dialogue.English: Aki, got it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 骨盤骨折だと仕事に復帰するまでの時間もかかりそうですね。。
dialogue.English: With a pelvic fracture, it seems like it might take a long time before you can return to work.

dialogue.content: それはお辛いと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine that must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい、まだ見通しがつきません
dialogue.English: Yes, I still don't have a clear outlook.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: このことを相談出来る方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have anyone you can talk to about this?

dialogue.content: いえ、いないです
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私は病院で看護助手として働いているのですが、整形外科の病棟にいるので、アキさんと似たような状況の患者さんもいらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: I actually work as a nursing assistant at a hospital, on the orthopedic ward, so I see patients in situations similar to yours.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: リハビリを考えると何か月仕事できないんだろうって
dialogue.English: Thinking about rehab, I wonder how many months I won't be able to work.

dialogue.content: 手術して怪我が治ってもリハビリが始まりますよね。。
dialogue.English: Even after surgery and the injury heals, rehabilitation begins, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: それはお辛いと思います。
dialogue.English: I imagine that must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい、入院して一週間目なんです。まだあまり動けません
dialogue.English: Yes, it's been a week since I was admitted. I still can't move much.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 入院しているお部屋は共同部屋ですか？
dialogue.English: Is your hospital room a shared one?

dialogue.content: はい、4人部屋に2人で
dialogue.English: Yes, there are two of us in a four-bed room.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、一緒のお部屋に入院している方とはお話ししますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you talk with the other person in your room?

dialogue.content: 挨拶程度です、私がロクに動けないので
dialogue.English: Just to say hello. I can't really move around properly.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: なかなか話せないと辛い気持ちを抱えてしまって不安な思いも膨らんでしまいますよね。。
dialogue.English: When you can't talk to anyone, it's easy to hold onto those difficult feelings, and the anxiety can build up, can't it?

dialogue.content: はい。。。
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: そのお部屋にテレビやラジオはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there a TV or radio in your room?

dialogue.content: もしくはアキさんのケータイなど、、
dialogue.English: Or maybe your phone...

dialogue.content: はい、テレビあります
dialogue.English: Yes, there's a TV.

dialogue.content: スマホも
dialogue.English: And a smartphone too.

dialogue.content: 気持ちを軽くするためにも明るい内容の番組など見てみてはどうでしょう？
dialogue.English: To help lighten your mood, how about watching some uplifting programs?

dialogue.content: You Tubeで明るい曲を聴くなどもいかがでしょう?
dialogue.English: Or how about listening to some upbeat music on YouTube?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's a good idea.

dialogue.content: 探してみます
dialogue.English: I'll look for some.

dialogue.content: きっと気持ちが軽くなると思います
dialogue.English: I'm sure it will help lighten your mood.

dialogue.content: はい、そうかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Yes, you might be right.

dialogue.content: やってみます
dialogue.English: I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 看護師さんとお話しするのもいいかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: It might also be good to talk with the nurses.

dialogue.content: はい！よかったですです
dialogue.English: Yes! That's great.

dialogue.content: 看護師さんとは何を話せばいいですか。すごく忙しそうです
dialogue.English: What should I talk to the nurses about? They seem so busy.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 入院している病院には看護助手の方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Does the hospital you're in have nursing assistants?

dialogue.content: ちょっと見分けがつかないけど居ると思います
dialogue.English: I can't quite tell them apart, but I think so.

dialogue.content: もしいそうでしたら、看護師さんよりも看護助手さんの方が多少時間に余裕があると思うので、看護助手さんとお話しするなど、、
dialogue.English: If there are, nursing assistants might have a little more time than the nurses, so you could try talking with them...

dialogue.content: しかし見分けがつかないと難しそうですね。。
dialogue.English: But it might be difficult if you can't tell them apart...

dialogue.content: はい、制服がみんなバラバラで
dialogue.English: Yes, everyone's uniforms are different.

dialogue.content: いろんな色の服を着てますよね、、
dialogue.English: They wear all kinds of colors, don't they...

dialogue.content: リハビリは始まってますか？
dialogue.English: Has your rehabilitation started?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まだトイレも行けてません
dialogue.English: I still can't even go to the toilet.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 食事はご自分でされてますか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to eat by yourself?

dialogue.content: はい、少しベッドに角度付けて
dialogue.English: Yes, with the bed raised slightly.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: もし看護士さんに手伝ってもらっているのでしたら、その時にお話しをするなど考えてみたのですが、、
dialogue.English: I was thinking that if a nurse helps you with anything, you could talk to them then...

dialogue.content: 難しいですね。。
dialogue.English: It's difficult, isn't it...

dialogue.content: ああ
dialogue.English: Ah.

dialogue.content: 何か思いつきましたか？
dialogue.English: Did something come to mind?

dialogue.content: 身体拭いてくれます
dialogue.English: They help me with sponge baths.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか!その時間に看護士さんとお話しすることは出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: Oh, I see! Do you think you could talk with the nurse during that time?

dialogue.content: はい、出来そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, I think I could.

dialogue.content: 孤独で不安って言えばいいですか？怪我の事じゃないけど
dialogue.English: Should I tell them I'm lonely and anxious? Even though it's not about the injury itself.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、仕事のことが言いづらければ今の思いを話してみるとか、相談出来そうであればそのままお話ししてみるなど。。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's a good idea. If it's difficult to talk about work, you could just share how you're feeling right now, or if you feel you can, you could talk about the whole situation.

dialogue.content: 看護士さんも優しい方がたくさんいらっしゃると思うので、お話しするだけでも気持ちが軽くなると思います
dialogue.English: I'm sure there are many kind nurses, so just talking with them might help you feel a bit better.

dialogue.content: 今はまだ一週間なので仕事先から何も言われてないけど
dialogue.English: It's only been a week, so I haven't heard anything from my workplace yet, but...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: これからクビとかなったら
dialogue.English: if I end up getting fired...

dialogue.content: そんな時も看護師さんでいいですか
dialogue.English: Can I still talk to a nurse about that?

dialogue.content: とても不安ですよね。。
dialogue.English: That must make you very anxious.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、より深いお話しをするのであれば、短い時間では厳しい面もありますよね。。
dialogue.English: That's true... for a deeper conversation, a short amount of time might not be enough...

dialogue.content: 何だか全てが不安で
dialogue.English: I just feel anxious about everything.

dialogue.content: 仕事先には今の状況は伝えてありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you informed your workplace of your current situation?

dialogue.content: はい、決まった派遣先に行けなくなってますから
dialogue.English: Yes, since I can't go to the assigned placement.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それはとてもお辛いのですよね。。
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you...

dialogue.content: 今月はいいけど今働けない分は来月の収入に響くので
dialogue.English: This month is fine, but since I can't work now, it will affect my income next month.

dialogue.content: 入院後の生活にも不安が残りますよね。。
dialogue.English: You must have concerns about your life after you're discharged, too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今動けないと3月の仕事もどうなるか
dialogue.English: If I can't move now, I don't know what will happen with my work in March.

dialogue.content: 不安です
dialogue.English: I'm anxious.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: 今は一人暮らしですか？
dialogue.English: Are you living alone right now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 入院後しばらくは親御さんにサポートしてもらうことはできそうですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be possible to get support from your parents for a while after you're discharged?

dialogue.content: 実家は田舎なのでたよれません
dialogue.English: My family home is in the countryside, so I can't rely on them.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 近くに頼れそうな知人やご近所の方もいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Are there any acquaintances or neighbors nearby you could rely on?

dialogue.content: それか支援金などは活用できそうですか？
dialogue.English: Or could you possibly make use of any financial support programs?

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間になってしまったので終了させていただきたいのですが、アキさんのお気持ちはまだ不安を抱えてらっしゃると思うので、またの機会にお話しを聞かせていただけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up, so I need to wrap up our session. However, I know you are still feeling anxious, so I would be happy to listen again at another time.

dialogue.content: 友人はいるけど、今まで頼ったりする関係じゃないから
dialogue.English: I have friends, but we don't have the kind of relationship where I'd ask for help.

dialogue.content: 大人の友人ってそうじゃないですか
dialogue.English: That's how adult friendships are, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.content: 私の力不足でアキさんの不安な気持ちを取り除くことができず、すみません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry that I wasn't able to do more to alleviate your anxiety.

dialogue.content: でも、看護師さんにとりあえず相談してみます
dialogue.English: But I'll try talking to a nurse for now.

dialogue.content: それが良いと思います
dialogue.English: I think that's a good idea.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: アキさんのことを応援しています
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for you, Aki.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
